predecessors.name: South African Republic (Transvaal)
predecessors.text: 'The Transvaal Colony lay between Vaal River in the south and the Limpopo River in the north'; approximate coordinates 22.5 to 27.5 S and 25 to 32 E

successors.name: South Africa
successors.text: the colony without the districts given to Natal in 1903

ledger.x: 31 May 1902: the Treaty of Vereeniging makes the former South African Republic a British colony.
January 1903: the Vryheid, Utrecht and Wakkerstroom districts pass to Natal.
31 May 1910: the Transvaal Colony becomes the Transvaal Province of the Union of South Africa.

certainty.note: A colony of the republic's former boundaries; the Natal transfer of 1903 is the only dated change.
